note: Guide: the approved motion, animate-spin spinners included, must honour prefers-reduced-motion (3218-3219). The only global guard stops animate-pulse; Tailwind animate-spin (5 views) has none, only sso/hand_back adds motion-reduce.
Guide: ac-option-active is the keyboard-selected option "with brand ring" (2351). CSS paints an 18% success-green tint and a 3px inset green bar, no brand ring. ac-option min-h-9 matches 2350.
Guide: never text-xs for labels users need (494). The group header that names each result group is text-xs uppercase muted. Separator between groups matches 2352.
Guide: text-xs only for badges and similar, never labels a reader needs (480-494). Filter chips, toggle controls, label at text-xs; min-h-9 and focus ring match. Active hover mixes in literal black.
Guide: never text-sm for empty-state messages (518). ac-empty is text-sm muted. ac-error text-sm is allowed (507); ac-loading has no rule.
Guide token tables: success borders border-success/30, soft surfaces bg-success/10 (406, 419). The success callout uses bg-success/5 and border-success/20.

Guide: warning borders border-warning/30 (420). The warning callout uses a full-strength border-warning, and an unlayered rule forces every descendant except .btn/.badge to amber ink, body text included.
Guide token tables: border-error/30, bg-error/10 (409-410, 421). The error callout uses bg-error/5 and border-error/20.
Guide: button-row gaps are gap-2 or gap-4 (553). The row uses 1.5vh row gap and 1.5vw column gap, viewport-relative (about 6px on a phone, 29px at 1920). md stacking is the sanctioned use (2952).

Guide: motion is functional only, from an approved set, and honours prefers-reduced-motion (3218-3220). Keyframed scale bounce and zoom-fade on copy (3 call sites), no reduced-motion rule; the guide's copy confirmation has no animation (1769).

Guide: buttons come from ButtonHelper, colour from the variant (1071, 1101). camera-capture-btn hand-styles a round bg-primary button with shadow and active:scale-95; camera-select is a hand-rolled select, not daisyUI select (FORM-01).
Guide documents inline-flex-center mapping to inline-flex items-center (645, 652). No such @utility exists in flex-patterns.css, so the class would compile to nothing; no call site uses it.

Guide: never text-xs for labels a reader needs (489-494). hero-stat-label is 0.75rem. Also a decorative warning-to-error gradient (flame) and a new pinned gold (award) against 180-188; values off the type scale.

Guide: non-semantic amber is three documented legacy pieces, not to be extended (180-188). hero-stat-award pins a new gold, oklch(50% 0.13 85) / oklch(83% 0.17 90), and flame mixes warning into error for decoration.

Guide: md marks only button-row stacking and its spacer (2947-2961). hq-window.css:37 adds an md-to-lg band laying the HQ summary out as a row. Literal 1024px also at mega-menu.css:20, label-value.css:33 (BP-02).
Guide: write the lg fold through theme(--breakpoint-lg) (2924-2925). @media (width >= 1024px) literal. Label/value displays otherwise have no rule.

Guide: write the lg fold as theme(--breakpoint-lg) (2924-2925). Uses @media (min-width: 1024px); min-width avoids the overlap bug. Otherwise undocumented: full-screen dialog, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5) backdrop, shadow-xl.

pattern=navigation Guide: write the lg fold as theme(--breakpoint-lg) (2924-2925). mega-menu.css uses literal @media (min-width: 1024px); being min-width it matches lg: exactly, so no dead band, only the literal.

Guide: <h3>/<h4> take heading-title, one style per level (532-534). These go on <h3> (text-lg semibold muted) and <h4> (text-sm semibold muted) in me/menu/_content: own sizes and muted ink on headings.
Guide: 36px floor, min-h-9 for a bare link (572-576). mega-menu-item-link is a link with py-1 and min-h-8 (32px); a title-only item measures about 25px of content, so it renders 32px.

Guide: modal titles take text-heading-primary (971). modal-title-text sets text-xl font-semibold text-base-content, body ink at L40 rather than heading ink. The four utilities are otherwise undocumented (the guide shows daisyUI modal-box/modal-action).
Guide: a new component gets no shadow (610). The sticky VC action bar carries shadow-sm (plus transition-all 200ms); used once in vc/applications/_action_bar.
Guide: one neutral utility per purpose (983). Labels use text-sm text-base-content/60, off the ladder. Bar gradient and pulse match 724 and 733; the 500ms width transition has no reduced-motion rule.

Guide composition: p-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider overflow-hidden text-ellipsis (2251). CSS: px-3 py-1 text-sm uppercase overflow-hidden text-ellipsis, no semibold, no tracking, tighter vertical padding.
Guide composition: inline-flex min-w-[1.125rem] h-4.5 ms-2 px-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-full (2252). CSS: @apply badge badge-sm ms-2, daisyUI's small badge instead.

Guide: entrance animations are decorative and avoided; approved motion must honour prefers-reduced-motion (3218-3220). Toasts slide in from translateX(100%) over 300ms with no reduced-motion rule. Composition matches 875.
Approved motion lists spinners, the progress pulse, urgent badges, the sidebar slide (3218-3219). The toast countdown bar animates its width with no reduced-motion rule; undocumented class.
Guide: text-xs never for labels or content a reader needs (489-494). Section-jump status pills label at text-xs; neutral uses text-base-content/60 off the ladder. min-h-9 matches TOUCH-01.

Guide: colour never decoration; non-semantic amber is three documented legacy pieces, not to extend (153, 178, 180-188). The panel adds an amber gradient frame, radial amber wash and warm glow; also sm: padding outside field widths (BP-01).
Guide: no coloured decoration (153, 178). A page-sized Rangers logo mask filled with warning at 20% sits behind the sign-in door, decoration in the status colour.
Guide: form labels are text-base, never text-sm (469, 516). Login labels and the forgot-password link are 0.8125rem, below text-sm. The required asterisk is hidden too (FORM-03 asks for it).

Guide: no hand-applied colour on a button, colour and hover come from the variant (1101-1103). Layers a warning gradient face, warm shadow, brightness hover and a 1px press translate over the helper's variant.
Guide: no coloured decoration, links in primary (153, 157). Amber top edge, amber wash and amber links and icons; lede at 0.8125rem and descriptions at 0.85rem sit below text-base (TYPE-03).

Guide radius table: buttons and inputs take rounded-base, 12px (588). daisyUI draws every btn and input at --radius-field, 0.5rem (8px), so ButtonHelper buttons and builder inputs are 8px while rounded-base call sites are 12px.

Guide stack (433-434) lists ui-monospace and monospace as generic keywords; CSS quotes them ("ui-monospace", "monospace"), which makes them family names that match nothing, so if the mono woff2 fails the fallback is the next named font, never the generic.
